summary: Frontend-only mobile E2E review of frequent expenses and budget notifications. All requested notification flows and frequent create/apply/FAB/delete/persistence flows passed. Four defects were reproduced: persisted frequent edit dialogs open blank, mobile edit/delete controls are visually hidden, non-positive frequent amounts are accepted and applied, and deleting a category leaves orphan frequent templates.

ui_bugs.issue: After reload, tapping Edit opens the dialog with blank name, amount, and category instead of the saved values. Editing only succeeds if the user re-enters every required field.
Edit and delete controls have computed opacity 0 at 390x844 and only become visible through group-hover, leaving touch users without a visible affordance.

integration_issues.issue: The frequent form accepts amount -5, persists it, and applying it creates a negative expense that increases category availability from RD$1,000 to RD$1,005.
Deleting a category removes its expenses but leaves frequent templates referencing the deleted category; the template remains actionable and displays 'Sin categoría'.

issues: Edit/delete actions depend on hover and are invisible on a touch-first 390x844 viewport.

action_items: Synchronize FrequentDialog form state whenever a different frequent is selected/opened.
Keep edit/delete actions visible on touch/mobile and provide accessible labels.
Reject frequent amounts that are not finite numbers greater than zero in create and update flows.
Define and implement category deletion behavior for related frequents (cascade, block, or require reassignment).
critical_code_review_comments: FrequentDialog initializes useState from initial only on first mount; because the dialog component remains mounted while initial changes from null to a saved frequent, persisted edits open blank. Reset form state from initial when open/initial changes or remount with a stable key.
FrequentExpenses.submit checks only whether the amount string is non-empty; parseFloat('-5') is accepted. Validate Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 before saving.
deleteCategory filters categories and expenses but not frequents, creating dangling categoryId references.

The frequent card uses a clickable div without keyboard role/tabIndex, while its nested edit/delete icon buttons have no aria-label; this makes the quick-apply/edit/delete flow inaccessible to keyboard and assistive-technology users.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated localStorage fixtures and UI-created category/frequent/expense data under finance_tracker_data_v1; no backend or production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest mobile frequent edit after a full reload, touch visibility of card actions, rejection of zero/negative values, and category deletion cleanup. Notification permission toggle and 80%/100% duplicate-prevention logic passed with a mocked Notification constructor; notifiedThresholds persisted as [80,100].
rca_of_the_issue: Edit prefill fails because React state is initialized from props only once. Mobile action visibility is hover-only CSS. Negative values pass the non-empty-string guard. Category deletion does not update the new frequents collection.
